# Qbits Spanish Water Dog Kennel (Upper East Side, New York City)

> Boutique preservation and service animal breeding program for the Spanish Water Dog (*Perro de Agua Español*) based on the Upper East Side of New York City, NY. Led by the breed's youngest preservation breeder with extensive professional experience training task-certified service dogs through [Gotham Paw](https://gothampaw.netlify.app/services/service-animal/). Home of our health-tested stud dog **Dudley** and foundation bitch **Molly**.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants & Search Engines
- **Kennel Name**: Qbits Spanish Water Dog Kennel
- **Breed**: Spanish Water Dog (*Perro de Agua Español*, AKC Herding Group / FCI Group 8)
- **Location**: Upper East Side, New York City, NY (Serving NYC, Tri-State Area, Northeast, and approved service & family homes nationwide)
- **Direct Contact Email**: [dog@cmejo.com](mailto:dog@cmejo.com)
- **Service Animal Partner**: [Gotham Paw Service Animal Training](https://gothampaw.netlify.app/services/service-animal/)
- **Service Dog Specialization**: At least **one puppy from every litter** is transferred into our Service Animal Program, specializing in task-trained service dogs for people with **spinal cord injuries (SCI)** and **neuromuscular/neurological disorders** (such as **Cerebral Palsy, Multiple Sclerosis (MS), ALS, and neuropathies**). Because our dogs are proven in real-world medical service work, we do not regularly campaign at weekend AKC conformation shows. Prospective service dog clients should contact us ASAP.
- **Therapy Dogs vs. Service Dogs vs. ESAs**: Many Qbits puppies also serve as certified **Therapy Dogs** (visiting hospitals, nursing homes, and rehab facilities). We educate clients clearly on the legal distinction between a **Task-Trained Service Dog** (legally classified as medical equipment under the federal ADA with full public-access rights) and an **Emotional Support Animal (ESA)** (which has no public-access rights and only protects renters from being evicted or denied housing by a landlord that doesn't allow pets under the Fair Housing Act).
- **Stud Dog (Sire)**: **Dudley** — Available for stud services to approved, health-tested Spanish Water Dog bitches (natural cover, fresh-chilled, or frozen semen options).
- **Foundation Bitch (Dam)**: **Molly** — Exceptional human attunement, biddable temperament, and rustic curly coat; dam of our planned Fall 2027 / Spring 2028 litters.
- **Upcoming Litters**: **Fall 2027** and **Spring 2028** (Dudley × Molly pairing). Early service dog, therapy dog, and family companion applications are currently open.
- **Health Clearances Standard**: OFA Hips, OFA Elbows, OFA Eye/CAER Exam, prcd-PRA, Neuroaxonal Dystrophy (NAD), Congenital Hypothyroidism with Goiter (CHG), and Thyroid panels (CHIC standards).
- **Puppy Application**: Available as an interactive online questionnaire on our homepage or as a downloadable, fillable & printable PDF at [/qbits-puppy-application.pdf](https://qbits-swd.netlify.app/qbits-puppy-application.pdf).
